- Only `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` differs from main.
- The version increases by exactly one and retains its final newline.
- `git diff --check` passed.

Build, Cargo tests, and Clippy were not run. This one-line metadata change has no executable behavior. No GitHub runner was used.

The PR changes no posted G-code, safety checks, stock simulation, geometry, UI, or goldens. Mutation tests and screenshots do not apply.

Requested changes: none.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
